criteria.requirement: Open-Source Grounding: Ingest unclassified commercial and open maritime feeds (AIS, IMO ship registries, OFAC/EU sanctions).
criteria.detail: Approved real AIS, IMO registry, OFAC/EU snapshots with provenance and permitted usage are absent and prohibited by this synthetic-only workspace. Fictional snapshots demonstrate the full workflow but cannot establish real open-source grounding; live acquisition also needs separately authorized connectors.

criteria.requirement: Zero Hallucination Tolerance: 100% of claims must link to an immutable captured source snapshot; unresolved queries must declare "Unknown".
criteria.detail: In the explicitly synthetic complete workflow, every factual brief claim resolves to a permitted exact original span, revision, capture and observation timestamps and a verified captured-content digest; unsupported intent, flag, sanctions applicability and conflicting AIS remain UNKNOWN. Same-name identities require deliberate selection. The Cited Contact Brief exports with a resolvable offline Evidence Appendix and Identity Resolution Record. Integrity failures block affected claims and export; local review preserves saved and unsaved interpretation separately. Synthetic evaluation is generated, but this does not establish real-format compliance, production immutability, owner acceptance or operational validation. — demonstrated by brief-export, ambiguous-name, input-recovery, missing-stale, permitted-evidence, integrity-recovery, import-conflict, review-boundary, synthetic-evaluation at both viewport sizes.

criteria.requirement: Every result cites an exact permitted source span.
criteria.detail: The denied snapshot is the strongest unfiltered lexical match but is removed before identity matching, retrieval, viewing and export. ALDER REACH owner North Lantern returns only REG-A and its exact owner span; no denied content or unsupported claims appear in any result or portable export. An allowed flag is a synthetic filtering fixture, not authorization. — demonstrated by permitted-evidence, brief-export at both viewport sizes.

The fixed synthetic as-of and more-than-30-day policy expose PORT-A observation as STALE despite fresh capture; OFAC observation time and absent flag, EU applicability and intent are UNKNOWN. One future snapshot is excluded. No-match and conflicting AIS conclusions abstain; restoration and corrected identifiers recover without guessed facts. — demonstrated by missing-stale, input-recovery, import-conflict at both viewport sizes.

criteria.requirement: Measure relevance and latency with the owner.
criteria.detail: No participating owner can review labels, assess relevance or accept measured results in this unattended run. The local report explicitly says PENDING; synthetic labels and automated timing cannot substitute for that person’s participation.
